messages:
sam_csm: Heads up — Mosaic renewal needs signing EOW. Quick list of open items: customer wants a 9mo term, procurement requires a PO and vendor paperwork, finance needs vendor code + VAT/W-9, and onboarding flagged seat-count variance. Can we run through blockers?

owen_sales: They want 9mo to line up with their budget. They'll take ~10% discount if payment is net30. I asked for a confirmation email from their CFO.

jess_onboarding: Seat count changed on their side — engineering reported 12 active seats vs 15 on last commit. Need the final roster to calculate proration/true-up.

maria_billing: I can pull vendor code but AP needs a W-9 (or VAT) before we can accept a PO. Tentative vendor code on file: 988-M, will verify. If they push CC instead of PO we need to confirm fee handling.

aiden_success_ops: Suggested approach: accept 9mo term, apply prorated seat adjustment on first invoice, and include a one-time onboarding credit in the amendment. Is @owen_sales ok proposing that to the customer?

owen_sales: Yes propose 9mo + 10% discount contingent on PO and net30 payment. I'll get their PO commitment once we share vendor paperwork and contract amendment.

laila_legal: Please don't send any redlines to customer without legal sign-off. I'll need to review amendment changing Term from 12mo -> 9mo and adjust termination/guarantee clauses. Current draft label: `v3-redline-2026-03-18`.

sam_csm: I'll draft the amendment and share for legal review. For signatures, procurement says DocuSign but their SSO blocks external links sometimes. @docu_sign_bot any known workarounds?

docu_sign_bot: Recommend using an envelope configured for Service Provider pre-registered signers or sharing a one-time access link. See internal runbook: https://intra.redwood/docusign/runbook (internal-only).

maria_billing: If they need invoice splitting across entities we need billing contact + VAT ID before issuing invoice. Can we collect that now?

jess_onboarding: I'll DM the customer success contact now for seat roster + billing contact.

owen_sales: Customer responded: "We can issue PO by Wed if you provide vendor code + W-9 today."

aiden_success_ops: Action items summarized: Sam to draft amendment and include onboarding credit, Laila to review legal redline, Maria to confirm vendor code + attach W-9, Jess to collect seat list and billing contact, Owen to confirm PO timeline with the customer. I'll compile and circulate the packet by EOD.

sam_csm: Draft will include a one-time onboarding credit and a sample line-item breakout, e.g.:

```
Onboarding Credit: -$2,000
Prorated seats (3 seats @ $250/mo for 9mo) = $6,750
Subtotal: ...
```

laila_legal: I'll aim to complete review by tomorrow morning. If Term changes to 9mo we need to update the SLA termination notice and the automatic renewal clause.

maria_billing: Confirmed — vendor code 988-M is active and W-9 uploaded to shared drive. Sending W-9 to @owen_sales now.

owen_sales: Got it. I'll press customer to issue PO Wed morning. Thanks team :thumbsup:

sam_csm: Great — closing the loop for now. I'll post the final amendment once legal clears. Ping me directly for any urgent additions.
